title: Halo: The Fall of Reach
notes: Optional novel. Article: "The game Halo: Reach largely ignored the canon established in the book." Reissued by Tor on December 7, 2010. A full-cast audio adaptation was released November 10, 2026.

in_universe.note: The Fall of Reach takes place in the Halo universe and spans several decades, beginning in 2517 and describing events up to 2552.

release.note: Wikipedia: The book was released in October 2001 and is the first Halo novel.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
notes: Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary (Xbox 360, November 15, 2011); in Halo: The Master Chief Collection (2014).

in_universe.note: Halo: Combat Evolved takes place in a 26th-century science fiction setting. … In 2552, Covenant forces attack Reach and destroy the colony. … Reach takes place in a futuristic science fiction setting; the year is 2552, shortly before the events of the video game Halo: Combat Evolved

release.note: Wikipedia: The game was released on November 15, 2001 for the Xbox, with ports to Microsoft Windows and Mac OS X released in 2003.

in_universe.note: Halo 2 takes place in the 26th century. … Halo 3 is set in a science fiction setting during the years 2552 and 2553.

release.note: Wikipedia: Halo 2 was released on November 9, 2004, in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and the United States.

in_universe.note: Halo 3: ODST takes place between the events of Halo 2, and Halo 3.

release.note: Wikipedia: released = September 22, 2009 … The fifth installment in the Halo franchise, it was released on the Xbox 360 in September 2009.

links.note: runs during the Covenant assault on New Mombasa from Halo 2

in_universe.note: Halo 3 is set in a science fiction setting during the years 2552 and 2553.

release.note: Wikipedia: Halo 3 was released on September 25, 2007, in three separate retail versions: "Standard", "Limited", and "Legendary".

title: Halo: Reach
notes: Windows/Xbox One in The Master Chief Collection, December 3, 2019.

in_universe.label: 2552 (epilogue 2589)
in_universe.note: Reach takes place in a futuristic science fiction setting; the year is 2552, shortly before the events of the video game Halo: Combat Evolved, and during the events of the novel Halo: The Fall of Reach.

release.note: Wikipedia: Reach was released on September 14, 2010 in 25 countries.

links.note: article: Reach "largely ignored the canon established in the book"

title: Halo Wars
notes: Definitive Edition (343 Industries) December 2016. The release date is the first (Australian) one; North America March 3, 2009.

in_universe.note: The game is set in the science fiction universe of the Halo series in the year 2531, 21 years before the events of Halo: Combat Evolved.

release.note: Wikipedia: It was released in Australia on February 26, 2009; in Europe on February 27; and in North America on March 3.

in_universe.note: Halo 4 takes place in a futuristic science fiction setting in the year 2557, four years after the events of Halo 3.

release.note: Wikipedia: Halo 4 was released in all territories except Japan on November 6, 2012; the Japanese version was released on November 8.

in_universe.label: between Halo 3 and Halo 4
in_universe.note: Halo: Spartan Assault takes place in the 26th century between the events of Halo 3 and Halo 4.

release.note: Wikipedia: Part of the Halo franchise, the game was released on July 18, 2013, for Microsoft's Windows 8 and Windows Phone 8 platforms.

in_universe.note: Halo 5: Guardians takes place in the year 2558, eight months after the events of Halo 4.

release.note: Wikipedia: A sequel, Halo 5: Guardians, was released for the Xbox One on October 27, 2015.

in_universe.note: The game is set in 2559, 28 years after the events of Halo Wars and shortly after the events of Halo 5: Guardians.

release.note: Wikipedia: released = February 21, 2017 Released the same day on Windows and Xbox One.

title: Halo Infinite
notes: The halo-wars-2 link is the researcher's own judgement, not quoted from a source.

in_universe.label: 2560 (opens December 2559)
in_universe.note: Halo Infinite is set in the year 2560. … In December 2559, the UNSC ship Infinity arrives at Halo Installation 07.

release.note: Wikipedia: Following an open beta release of the multiplayer component on November 15, 2021, coinciding with the franchise's 20th anniversary, the campaign was released on December 8, 2021, for Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Campaign released the same day on Windows, Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S (free-to-play multiplayer open beta on the same three platforms on November 15, 2021).

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
notes: First Halo game released on PlayStation.

in_universe.note: The latest installment, Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remake of the original Combat Evolved campaign newly powered by Unreal Engine 5, was released in July 2026.

release.note: Wikipedia: Halo: Campaign Evolved was released for PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S on July 28, 2026. Released the same day on PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S.

title: Halo Legends
notes: Anthology of seven animated shorts; some streamed earlier on Halo Waypoint. Released on DVD/Blu-ray (home media).

in_universe.label: various (anthology)
in_universe.note: While all the stories save one are considered canon, O'Connor noted that some discrepancies were the cause of artistic interpretation.

release.note: Wikipedia: Halo Legends was originally to be released on February 9, but launch was pushed back a week to February 16.

title: Halo 4: Forward Unto Dawn
notes: Platform YouTube (Machinima). Film cut on Blu-ray/DVD December 4, 2012. Machinima credit from the franchise article ("Machinima's Halo 4: Forward Unto Dawn").

in_universe.label: 2526 (framing 2557)
in_universe.note: The protagonist, Thomas Lasky, is aboard a spaceship named the UNSC Infinity in 2557. … Forward Unto Dawn portrays his memory of the events on Circinius-IV in 2526, when he is a cadet at the Corbulo Academy, a training facility for the children of high-ranking UNSC officers.

release.note: Wikipedia: The series consists of five 15-minute shorts, the first released on October 5, 2012, with subsequent episodes released weekly.

title: Halo: Nightfall
notes: Released via the Halo Channel app (Xbox One, Windows 8.1, Windows Phone); disc and streaming release March 16, 2015. Episode count and exact first date not in fetched sources.

in_universe.label: before Halo 5 (Locke origin)
in_universe.note: The feature introduces a new character to the franchise, Agent Jameson Locke, played by actor Mike Colter; Nightfall is considered to be his origin story.

release.note: Wikipedia: On June 9, 2014, it was announced at E3 2014 that the feature, titled Halo: Nightfall, would be included with Halo: The Master Chief Collection at its November 2014 launch.

title: Halo
notes: Article: "In July 2024, the series was canceled after two seasons". UK: episode 1 on Channel 5, June 22, 2022.

in_universe.label: 26th century
in_universe.note: Halo is set in the 26th century and follows the conflict between humanity and a formidable alien alliance known as the Covenant.

release.note: Wikipedia: The first season of Halo premiered on March 24, 2022, and ran until May 19.

in_universe.label: after season 1
in_universe.note: No in-universe year in the sources.

release.note: Wikipedia: A second season premiered on February 8, 2024, and ran for eight episodes until March 21.
